name: ContactSection
description: Mortar marketing contact section, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.children: ReactNode (the form; optional when the section lists offices)
props.media: ReactNode (an image filling one half of a split layout beside the intro and form; give it alt text, or alt="" when decorative)
props.offices: { name: string; address: ReactNode }[] (office locations; each name is a heading one level below headingLevel and each address an <address>. Without a form they sit beside the intro, otherwise in a row below)
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)

contract.usage: Import { ContactSection } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook.
